headline: The Liquidation Trap: $159M TVL Meets $1.2M Swap Depth

blocks.text: 01 Seizure: Debt threshold breach activates liquidation against $159,033,033 Blend TVL
02 Funnel: Liquidators route seized collateral to decentralized exchange pools
03 Bottleneck: Swap depth exhausts against $1,239,028 Soroswap TVL

focal.reason: Exposes the fatal 128:1 liquidity mismatch where onchain liquidation capacity fails.
